title: Personal Time Capsule — preservation-log.yaml
description: Structural schema for a capsule's post-seal preservation log. See ../INTEGRITY.md for the field-by-field explanation and rationale. This file is deliberately NOT covered by manifest-sha256.txt or tagmanifest-sha256.txt — see INTEGRITY.md for why. Covers ROADMAP.md item 11 (integrity model) only.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for this entry, same purpose as data/provenance/events.yaml's id field.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the event occurred. Must be a quoted string, per the YAML gotcha documented in FORMAT.md.

type.description: The first 6 match the post-seal tail of capsule.yaml's status.lifecycle_stage enum (encryption is stage 6, immediately after sealing — see ENCRYPTION.md for why its event belongs here and not in data/provenance/events.yaml). fixity_check, succession_transfer, and trustee_attestation are the recurring sub-events LIFECYCLE.md stage 8 names. reseal is for the rare, explicitly-logged case where a capsule's payload manifest is legitimately regenerated after sealing — see INTEGRITY.md.

agent.description: Free text identifying who or what performed this event, same convention as data/provenance/events.yaml.

collection.description: Optional. Matches a collections[].name in capsule.yaml when the event concerns one named collection rather than the whole capsule.

outcome.description: Optional. Free-text result — most relevant for fixity_check (e.g. "pass", "checksum mismatch: data/photos/1998-07-04-lakehouse.jpg").

note.description: Optional. Any other free-text context worth recording.

manifest_checksum_before.description: reseal only: the manifest-sha256.txt checksum (of manifest-sha256.txt itself) prior to regeneration.

manifest_checksum_after.description: reseal only: the manifest-sha256.txt checksum after regeneration.
